en: Hey, are you one of the new recruits too? We took on a whole crowd for the Radio Tower job and ran short of uniforms.
The photo studio here keeps a rack of them for its pictures, so I'm helping myself. You'd better change too!
{player} pulled on a Team Rocket uniform from the studio's rack.
Look at you! Very sharp. Just don't go scaring people in the street dressed like that, all right?
